create_block_index: create a BlockIndex with length, block locations, and block lengths for sparse array representation
create_int_index: create an IntIndex with length and sorted indices array for sparse non-zero element tracking
create_sparse_index: create a sparse index using make_sparse_index with length, indices array, and kind integer or block
test_index_make_union: test BlockIndex and IntIndex make_union to compute the union of two sparse indices
test_sparse_index_intersect: test BlockIndex and IntIndex intersect to compute the intersection of two sparse indices
test_sparse_index_lookup: test sparse index lookup and lookup_array to map original positions to compressed indices
test_sparse_operators: test sparse arithmetic operations add sub mul truediv floordiv on BlockIndex and IntIndex
